resolution: Implemented independent Marker.Letter/Marker.Text and legacy Title reconciliation. Empty versus absent sections, Unicode/XML-sensitive text, programmatic captions, and exact final pinned-consumer values are covered. Narrow boundary-whitespace loss for CDATA terminators or carriage returns is reported explicitly. Fresh independent acceptance review, integrated full gates and the refreshed370-fixture probe passed.
